name: Gary L. Bradus
tagline: Top rated Business & Corporate attorney in Sacramento, California
education: University of California Los Angeles (UCLA) School of Law
about: Gary L. Bradus is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2026. He works at Weintraub Tobin, located in Sacramento, California, and provides legal services for issues involving Business / Corporate, Banking and Mergers & Acquisitions to the surrounding community.
Gary Bradus completed legal studies at University of California Los Angeles (UCLA) School of Law and graduated with the class of 1987. Gary Bradus passed the bar in 1987.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
